answer: Proof-of-Space-Time deters Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to seal a key-salted, incompressible dataset and answer rapid Merkle challenges across epochs. Unique sealing prevents deduplication so one host cannot cheaply harbor clones across opal trading or knoll telemetry tasks, forcing attackers to dedicate persistent disk capacity and IOPS per identity. However, large datacenters pay lower marginal storage rates, and fast accelerators can substitute compute for partial plot storage.
